responsibility: This file parses and resolves Fortran I/O statements and FORMAT specifications in the front end. It defines the recognized I/O tags for OPEN/CLOSE/READ/WRITE/PRINT/INQUIRE/WAIT and related statements, matches their syntax into dedicated gfc_* I/O structures, validates PURE-procedure and label constraints, parses FORMAT strings into an internal checked form, and resolves tag expressions and variable-definition contexts before later lowering to runtime I/O calls.
